sources.name: monthly_unemployment
notes: The population excludes institutionalized people.
An unemployed person has no paid work, recently looked for work, and is directly available for work.
Use monthly period keys only; the same table also contains quarterly and annual observations.
The Age key is fixed-width and contains three trailing spaces; preserve them in API filters.
CBS did not apply a greater-than-or-equal range comparison to the coded Periods dimension; the raw layer therefore keeps all monthly history and staging applies the 2015 cutoff.
Retain the CBS-published rate instead of recalculating it from rounded counts.

sources.name: quarterly_unfilled_vacancies
notes: The measure is the stock of unfilled vacancies at the end of each quarter.
Use this national total before adding an economic-activity breakdown.
The 2026 observations were provisional when checked.
Observation status is stored in the Periods dimension metadata and must be retained during staging.
Do not combine quarterly vacancies directly with monthly unemployment without an explicit alignment rule.

sources.name: monthly_negotiated_wages
sources.table_title: Cao wages, contractual wage costs and working hours; index (2020=100)
sources.available_period: Monthly figures from 2020; longer annual history

HourlyCaoWagesInclSpecialPayments_4.label: Hourly cao wages including special payments

HourlyCaoWagesInclSpecialPayments_11.label: Year-on-year change in hourly cao wages including special payments

notes: Use current figures rather than first-published figures for the MVP.
The Version key is fixed-width and contains three trailing spaces.
Monthly observations in this 2020-base table begin in 2020, so wage and real-wage analysis will begin later than unemployment analysis.
The measure covers employees under collective labour agreements and is not the same as average earnings for every worker.
The 2026 observations were provisional when checked and may be revised.

sources.name: monthly_consumer_prices
sources.table_title: Consumer prices; CPI 2025=100, index and rates of change

raw_extraction_scope.coverage: all available periods for all items

notes: Use the national all-items CPI rather than HICP for the MVP purchasing-power comparison.
The all-items dimension key is fixed-width and contains two trailing spaces.
Use monthly observations only; the table also contains annual periods.
CBS rebased the CPI from 2015=100 to 2025=100 in 2026 and provides the rebased history back to December 2009.
Use the CBS-published annual rate of change as the inflation measure.
Retain final/provisional status from the Periods resource; August 2026 was provisional when checked.
Stage from January 2020 to align CPI with the selected wage series for real-wage analysis.
